name: guard-basefee-opcode-at-london
source: synthetic (step 03 reviser, round 2) -- inherited-obligation regression guard
rationale: EIP-3198 defines BASEFEE (0x48) from London. Slot 0 holds the opcode's value plus one, so a tool that leaves 0x48 undefined (Berlin behaviour, which reverts the frame and stores nothing) is charged here.
